senses.en_definition: An exclamation expressing surprise, dismay, or annoyance, especially at a minor mishap.

messages.en: Oh no, I left my wallet at home! Have you ordered yet?
Yeah. No worries, I'll cover you for now. Just transfer me the money later.
Have you sent me your new home address yet?
Not yet. I'll send it now, along with a pin on the map.

senses.en_definition: A reason, explanation, or evidence given to support an action, opinion, or decision.
The basis or foundation on which something rests or is established.
An object or material placed underneath something to support or cushion it.

messages.en: I can't make it tonight. I've got to work late. Hope you don't think I'm making excuses again.
Hey, of course not. If you've got to work, just say so. We can meet up another time.

senses.en_definition: A tool, instrument, or device used to carry out a task or perform a particular function.
A person or thing used as a means of achieving a purpose, especially someone else's.

collocations.en: a tool of the colonial rulers

senses.en_definition: A body organ that performs a particular physiological function.

messages.en: Mum, where are the tools for fixing the bike? I need to tighten this screw.
In the blue box in the storeroom. Just grab a screwdriver. No need to bring all the tools over.
